The files in this folder hold data of the Slovenian Environment Agency
(Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje, ARSO), measured by its automatic
weather stations and published on meteo.arso.gov.si, whose terms of reuse,
https://meteo.arso.gov.si/uploads/meteo/help/sl/copyright.html, make it
freely available for reuse with the source named:

    Vir: ARSO (Source: ARSO)

They are not covered by the licence of the code around them.

They were recorded on 2026-11-22 from https://meteo.arso.gov.si/, without
a key, with curl, single GET requests.

observationAms_si_latest.xml is the answer to the adapter's one request,

    GET /uploads/probase/www/observ/surface/text/sl/observationAms_si_latest.xml
        asked at 08:20:06 UTC (Date 08:20:07 GMT, Last-Modified 07:58:54
        GMT), 811,155 bytes (28,173 gzipped), 103 stations; values of the
        ten minutes to 07:50 UTC at 87 stations and of the half hour to
        07:30 UTC at the 16 main ones

cut down to fifteen of its stations. The file is one line: a head of
elements about the file, then one <metData> per station, then </data>. The
cut keeps the head and the fifteen <metData> elements byte for byte, in
their order, and the closing </data>; a script checked that the head, all
103 elements and the close put together again are the file. The fifteen,
by ARSO's id:

    south of 46.3 N (the southern box, 9.4 to 17.2 E, 43.5 to 46.3 N):
      KRVAVEC_, RATIT-VEC_, VOGEL_, SLAVNIK_ (mountains, with wind),
      NOVA-GOR_BILJE_ (wind and pressure), CELJE_MEDLOG_ (a main station,
      half-hourly), KOPER_LUKA_ (at -2 m), TRZAS-ZAL_ (a buoy in the Gulf of
      Trieste, with a gust and a direction of 0 and no mean),
      BABNO-POL_ (no anemometer)
    north of 46.3 N (the first region's box, 9.4 to 17.2 E, 46.3 to 48.5 N):
      KANIN_, KREDA-ICA_, ROGLA_, URSLJ-GOR_ (mountains, with wind),
      RATECE_, GORICKO_KRAJI-PAR_ (main stations whose wind was empty,
      with state 2)

The whole file had 103 stations, all inside the Alps' box (5.0 to 17.2 E,
43.5 to 48.5 N): 68 in the southern box and 35 in the first region's. 56
had a mean wind (40 south, 16 north), one more a gust only; 102 a
temperature, 20 a pressure at the station.

The folder evening/ holds three answers of ARSO's archive of measurements
(https://meteo.arso.gov.si/met/sl/archive/), whole and unchanged, asked at
about 08:25 UTC:

    evening/ID.xml   GET /webmet/archive/data.xml?lang=si&vars=12,2,4,21,23,24
                         &group=halfhourlyData0&type=halfhourly&id=ID
                         &d1=2026-11-18&d2=2026-11-18

for the stations 1820 (Kredarica), 1848 (Rogla) and 2845 (Uršlja gora):
their values of every ten minutes of 18 November 2026. The parameters are
12 (mean pressure, hPa), 2 (temperature at the term, °C), 4 (humidity at
the term, %), 21 (mean wind speed, m/s), 23 (mean direction, °) and 24
(strongest wind, m/s), as the archive's own settings
(/webmet/archive/settings.xml?lang=si) name them. A row's key counts
minutes, and it counts them on the clock in Slovenia: the archive's values
for 13:00 on 2026-11-20 are those that ARSO's two-day history of
Kredarica (/uploads/probase/www/observ/surface/text/sl/recent/
observationAms_KREDA-ICA_history.xml) gives for 12:00 UTC. The archive
rounds to one decimal (the pressure to whole hPa), and its mean direction
is a vector mean that differed from the history's by up to 11 degrees in
that comparison. The adapter does not ask the archive. These answers are
here for the next file.

observationAms_evening.xml is NOT an answer of ARSO as it gave it. It is a
sample for the server's development mode, whose clock stands at 19:05 UTC
on 2026-11-18, four days before this source was recorded; the latest file
holds the newest values only, and the two-day history did not reach back
that far. It is the head of observationAms_si_latest.xml and the
<metData> of KREDA-ICA_, ROGLA_ and URSLJ-GOR_ from it, with in each:

    the times set to the ten minutes to 18:50 UTC on 2026-11-18 (valid,
    valid_UTC, validStart, validEnd, tsValid_issued and its variants, the
    day's name "Sreda"), tsUpdated, sunrise and sunset emptied
    t, rh, ffavg_val (and ff_val), ddavg_val (and dd_val), ffmax_val set
    from the archive's row for 19:50 local time, that is 18:50 UTC; p from
    it only at Kredarica, the one of the three whose latest file has a
    pressure; their states set to 0
    every other value and state emptied, as the file writes an empty
    value (<x/>), and the webcams removed

So every value in the sample is one ARSO gave, for the station and the
moment the sample says. A test of this crate holds the sample against the
archive.

observationAms_empty.xml is the head of the recorded file with no station,
written by hand: ARSO was not seen to answer so.

observationAms_damaged.xml is not ARSO's data: it is the evening sample
with things changed and stations added by hand, to test how the adapter
reports what it cannot read. The test that uses it says what was changed.

To record them again: fetch the file, cut it down as above (the counts the
tests pin are of the fifteen stations and of that moment), set the moment
in tests/pipeline.rs, run the tests with VENTI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and review
what changed. The evening sample stays as it is for as long as the
development mode's clock does.

A value in these files is what an instrument reported. It is no statement
that a place can be flown.
